ALGER, 19 juillet 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: ALGIERS, July 19, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Several users reported this morning difficulties accessing the Instagram, Facebook and Messenger platforms, all three owned by the Meta group. The outage, identified shortly before 11 a.m., caused unavailability messages on Facebook.
Une interruption de service touche ce di: A service interruption affects the three main platforms of the Meta group this Sunday, July 19 in the morning: Instagram, Facebook and Messenger. Users report difficulty navigating these applications, with error messages such as “Your account is currently unavailable due to a site problem” being displayed on Facebook.
Selon les données de la plateforme DownD: According to data from the DownDetector platform, massive reports were recorded early in the morning, with a peak observed shortly before 11 a.m. The number of reports from users experiencing issues then began to decline by late morning. At the beginning of the afternoon, the situation returned to normal, with reports returning to a level close to that before the incident.
Les réseaux sociaux du groupe Meta ne so: The Meta group's social networks are not at their first major interruption. In November of the previous year, Facebook had already suffered difficulties when Cloudflare, a key player in internet security and performance, experienced a technical outage. These incidents are a reminder of the vulnerability of digital infrastructures to technical failures or cyber threats.
Pour l'heure, Meta n'a pas communiqué su: For the moment, Meta has not communicated on the exact nature of the outage or on the measures taken to remedy it. The group's technical teams could investigate possible server saturation or an internal technical failure.
